system.description:
An individual who seeks to learn about the world or a particular subject, who values the preservation and sharing of knowledge. They excel at gathering information more quickly and effectively than the average person and can support their allies with it.

The Scholar is a class for those who value gathering knowledge effectively and supporting their allies with it through effective buffs and debuffs.
triggers: You convince someone through logical arguments.
You share your knowledge with someone influential.
You successfully recall a rule your director doesn't remember.
complications: You learn something you really shouldn't have.
A secret society intends to silence you.
